Meta.title: Gymna — Your personal gym coach
Meta.description: A training plan built around your body, goals and health, with guided workouts and a coach you can message any time.

Common.notFoundBody: This page doesn't exist or has moved.

Landing.heroSubtitle: Tell Gymna about your body, your goal and any injuries. Get a weekly plan made for you, a demo for every exercise, and a coach who answers in seconds.
Landing.heroNote: Free to start. Takes about 3 minutes.

preview.coachMessage: Elbows at about 45°, not flared. Lower for two counts, then press.
preview.userMessage: My shoulders hurt on bench. Am I doing it wrong?

Landing.featuresSubtitle: Without the guesswork, and without waiting for your next session.

plan.title: A plan that fits you
plan.body: Your split, exercises, sets and rest come from your goal, level, schedule and equipment. Not a template.

safety.title: Works around injuries
safety.body: A short health check removes risky movements and swaps in safer ones for your back, knees or shoulders.

demos.title: A demo for every move
demos.body: See the movement, the muscles it trains, step-by-step cues and the mistakes to avoid.

session.title: Guided workout mode
session.body: One exercise at a time, big buttons, a set tracker and a rest timer that buzzes when it's time.

coach.title: A coach on chat
coach.body: Ask about form, soreness or what to eat after training. Answers know your plan and your health notes.

progress.title: Progress you can see
progress.body: Streaks, badges, training volume and body-weight charts keep you honest and motivated.

Landing.howTitle: From sign-up to first set in minutes

one.title: Tell us about you
one.body: Age, height, weight, goal, experience, training days and equipment.

two.title: Quick health check
two.body: A few yes or no questions so your plan respects your body.

three.title: Train with your plan
three.body: Open today's workout, follow the demos, log your sets and watch the numbers climb.

Landing.coachTitle: Feels like texting a real coach
Landing.coachBody: Describe how a lift felt and get clear corrections. Ask in Arabic or English. The coach stays on fitness and tells you to see a doctor when something needs one.

coachPoints.one: Knows your plan, level and injuries
coachPoints.three: Safe by design: no diagnoses, no crash diets

Landing.finalBody: Build your plan now and train today.

Footer.disclaimer: Gymna gives general fitness guidance. It does not replace a doctor, physiotherapist or certified trainer. Check with a doctor before starting a new exercise program, especially if you have a health condition or injury. Stop and seek medical help if you feel pain, dizziness or chest discomfort.

Dashboard.planSoonBody: Your weekly plan will be built from these answers. Plan generation is the next part of the app to be released.
Dashboard.clearanceTitle: Check with a doctor before training
Dashboard.clearanceBody: You reported: {items}. Get medical clearance first. Your plan will be conservative and will avoid movements that could aggravate these.

about.title: Let's start with you
about.subtitle: These numbers size your plan. They stay private.

bmi.title: Your BMI
bmi.empty: Enter your height and weight to see your BMI.
bmi.note: BMI is a rough guide. It can't tell muscle from fat.
bmi.scaleLabel: BMI {value} on a scale from 15 to 40

goal.title: What's your main goal?
goal.subtitle: It sets your reps, rest and exercise mix.

FAT_LOSS.title: Lose fat
FAT_LOSS.body: Higher reps, shorter rest, more work per session.

MUSCLE_GAIN.title: Build muscle
MUSCLE_GAIN.body: Moderate reps with enough volume to grow.

STRENGTH.title: Get stronger
STRENGTH.body: Heavier sets, lower reps, longer rest.

GENERAL_FITNESS.title: General fitness
GENERAL_FITNESS.body: A balanced mix to feel and move better.

level.title: How experienced are you?
level.subtitle: Be honest. Starting at the right level is how you progress fastest.

BEGINNER.title: Beginner
BEGINNER.body: New to training, or less than 6 months of it.

INTERMEDIATE.title: Intermediate
INTERMEDIATE.body: Training regularly for 6 months to 2 years.

ADVANCED.title: Advanced
ADVANCED.body: More than 2 years of consistent training.

schedule.title: When and where do you train?
schedule.subtitle: Pick what you can keep up every week.

DUMBBELLS.title: Home with dumbbells
DUMBBELLS.body: Dumbbells, with or without a bench.

health.title: A quick health check
health.subtitle: Answer honestly. A yes doesn't stop you training; it makes your plan safer.

questions.heartCondition: Has a doctor ever said you have a heart condition?
questions.chestPain: Do you get chest pain during activity or at rest?
questions.highBloodPressure: Do you have high blood pressure?
questions.dizziness: Do you lose balance from dizziness, or ever lose consciousness?
questions.lowerBack: Do you have a lower back injury or ongoing back pain?
questions.knee: Do you have a knee injury or ongoing knee pain?
questions.shoulder: Do you have a shoulder injury or ongoing shoulder pain?
questions.otherJoint: Any other joint problem (wrist, elbow, hip, ankle)?
questions.recentSurgery: Have you had surgery in the last 12 months?
questions.pregnancy: Are you pregnant, or did you give birth in the last 6 months?

health.notesPlaceholder: For example: old ankle sprain, asthma, medication…
health.noticeTitle: Please check with a doctor first
health.noticeBody: Based on your answers, get medical clearance before you start training. You can still build your plan now. We'll keep it conservative and leave out movements that could aggravate what you told us.
health.disclaimerLabel: I understand that Gymna gives general fitness guidance and does not replace a doctor or a certified trainer.
